summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $41.4M from $27.1M.
The net loss widened to $39.9M, or −$17.98 per share, from $29.2M. Operating cash flow was −$32.7M and free cash flow −$33.5M, versus −$24.0M; SpyGlass returned $1.4M through buybacks.
sources: SpyGlass Pharma, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
